attributes.name: Flaming Longbow +2
attributes.powers:
For your combat check, reveal this card to use your Dexterity or Ranged skill plus your Strength die + 2; you may additionally discard this card to add another 1d6 and the Fire trait. If you aren't proficient with weapons, the difficulty of this check is increased by 4.

If you are proficient with weapons, you may discard this card to add 1d4+1 and the Fire trait to any combat check at another location.
